name: adductor stretch
source_instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your ankles and sit tall.
Let your knees fall out to the sides.
Gently press your elbows on your thighs.
interpretation: Seated butterfly with soles together, both hands holding the ankles and long spine. Knees gently lower and open while elbows follow the thighs, hold for one second and return. The trunk stays fixed; the five-second preview abbreviates the source20–30second workout hold.
